reg  [5:0] a_reg;
reg  [7:0] b_reg;
reg [13:0] m_reg;

        a_reg <= 6'b0;
        b_reg <= 8'b0;
        m_reg <= 14'b0;

        a_reg <= a;
        b_reg <= b;
        m_reg <= a_reg * b_reg;
        c_reg <= c;
    end
end

assign p = m_reg + c_reg;

endmodule
